description_en: Queries the primary/secondary switching logs of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 查询实例的主备切换日志
name: DescribeDBInstanceSwitchLog

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-mm-ddThh:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and less than or equal to the maximum value supported by the integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：30、50、100，默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the replica set instance or the ID of the node on which a primary/secondary switchover is performed
NodeId.description_zh: 当实例为副本集实例，展示实例ID；当实例为分片集实例，展示切换的节点ID

SwitchCode.description_en:
The code that indicates the reason of a primary/secondary switchover. Valid values:

USER_CONSOLE_OPERATION: The switchover is manually performed.

OPERATION_AND_MAINTENANCE: Potential risks exist.

MACHINE_DOWNTIME: The host is offline.

PRIMARY_UNHEALTHY: An exception occurs on the primary node of the instance.

SECONDARY_UNHEALTHY: An exception occurs on the secondary node of the instance.

MULTIPLE_NODE_FAILURES: An exception occurs on multiple nodes of the instance
SwitchCode.description_zh:
切换原因代码：
USER_CONSOLE_OPERATION：人工操作
OPERATION_AND_MAINTENANCE：风险隐患
MACHINE_DOWNTIME：宿主机下线
PRIMARY_UNHEALTHY：实例异常
SECONDARY_UNHEALTHY：实例异常
MULTIPLE_NODE_FAILURES：实例异常

SwitchStatus.description_en: The switchover status. Valid values: 1 and 0. The value 1 indicates a successful primary/secondary switchover and the value 0 indicates a failed primary/secondary switchover
SwitchStatus.description_zh:
切换状态。
返回值为：
1：切换成功。
0：切换失败

SwitchTime.description_en: The point in time when a primary/secondary switchover was performed. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page

TotalCount.description_en: The number of primary/secondary switching entries
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询结果中主备切换记录的数量
